pages.text: Use an $(item)Astral Nexus$() orb on a Storage Nexus to bind it. Use the orb in air to open its Nexus.$(br2)Default range: $(bold)4,096 blocks$() in the same dimension. The Nexus and accessed storage must be loaded.$(br2)For other dimensions, hold the orb and a $(item)Dimensional Attunement$() in opposite hands, then use either item. One attunement is consumed in survival only when the upgrade succeeds.

pages.title: Wand and orb
pages.text: The wand assigns links. The orb opens its bound Nexus.

Remote connections do not load chunks.$(br2)Dimensional attunement unlocks other dimensions; it does not extend same-dimension range.$(br2)Astral Storage Crystals retain contents when moved. Their automatic links reform when placed within range of same-channel crystals.
